title: Wire account-scoped Cyclotron publication BFF after CMS rollout
description: Queued behind PPY-ca252a three-site CMS release, owned by ProductionCMS with integration-owner support. First inspect/pin Papyrus a23d6f4 and Cyclotron1e2a7a7 atop0b903779222fdab842caa077fd8bc645e96e23e4 in a new isolated feature branch. Wire a real production route adapter from trusted session selection and fresh central account plus explicit publication grants; preserve expected account/publication/binding pin, scoped cache/component identity and post-lock reauthorization. Given account/publication selection changes during dispatch or lock wait, stale results/writes are rejected before engine use. Given required grants are absent, deny without console-role inference. Run actual SDK/route/session tests before proposing activation. Storage authority decision is pending; do not choose persistence or activate cloud while unresolved. No dependency on optional priming or current shell/theme release.

comments.text: Integration inputs received, still queued behind terminal three-site CMS release. Latest human priming source is Papyrus 746aed6539f33288408c48e5d3f1f1fd988b5755: paper URL alone uses actual Biblicus/GROBID extraction; temporary Mac-only 127.0.0.1:8901 remains separate. No anonymous LAN or cloud activation authorized by this handoff. Web extraction must fail visibly until the published Biblicus contract and enforced provider budget are approved. Account-aware BFF source a23d6f4 / core 1e2a7a7 still requires isolated integration, trusted production session grants and explicit storage-authority decision before activation. Do not merge whole preview branches or infer publication grants from console roles.
